nodes.name: Model
nodes.notes: The one place to switch models. model = any id from https://router.huggingface.co/v1/models (append :provider to pin one, e.g. Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B:novita). vision = true only for models whose input_modalities include image — the cloth snapshot is dropped otherwise. reasoning_effort (low/medium/high) only for models that take it, e.g. openai/gpt-oss-120b.
